verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it speaks the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, with a dedicated drivers-and-clients page stating every ClickHouse client and driver works unchanged, so developers can build against the official ClickHouse drivers. There is no evidence of ObsessionDB's own first-party SDKs (e.g. for cluster management, branching, or monitoring APIs); CHKit is a schema/pipeline CLI and MCP is an agent integration, not SDKs. Missing for 10: first-party ObsessionDB SDKs in named languages, SDK reference docs, programmatic SDK coverage of ObsessionDB-specific features, independent corroboration.
